title: Demon Copperhead
author: Barbara Kingsolver
summary: A boy born in a trailer in Appalachian Virginia tells his own story. Foster homes, football, drugs and a failing community shape his rough road to adulthood.
readIf: you like a big, bruised, funny narrator and want to read about the opioid crisis from the inside.
skipIf: you cannot face a book where children are neglected and mistreated, or a long run of hard luck.

pairings.reason: The Dickens novel this one is openly modelled on, so you can enjoy spotting how each event is reborn.
Another American novel of poverty and dignity, with a similarly strong sense of anger on the characters' behalf.
Also follows a neglected child who grows up on the margins, though with a gentler and more romantic touch.
